purpose: Test whether the missing slower market context improves the same intraday prediction and execution task
hypothesis: The original feature set resets within each session and cannot explicitly condition an entry on prior market/sector trends or multi-day stock relative strength

data.source: Connected Alpaca SIP historical daily bars
data.required_action: Exclude 2026-10-28 and later rows, use only dates strictly before each stock decision date

features: current stock open versus prior complete session close
stock minus each market proxy prior 5-session return
four fixed macro/intraday trend, relative-strength, gap and VWAP interactions
selection: Report both candidates and both cost scenarios even if all lose; no automatic deployment or further search until profitable
limitations: Newly obtained historical bars are not contemporaneously archived receipts
Daily context rows repeat across intraday decisions and do not create independent sessions
Mixed SIP reference and Yahoo stock price sources
This is an intraday strategy with slow context, not a validated multi-week or fundamental investment model
